svg.title: Flask progression across 10 runs
svg.desc: Rows are the flask's two axes, columns are the two configurations. Each faint line is one Elden Ring slot of one generated multiworld; the solid line is the median across slots. Dashed rules mark each axis's maximum.
svg.text: One faint line per Elden Ring slot; the solid line is the median of those slots.
The dashed rule is the cap on that axis -- the most the game will ever give you.
